note: The endpoint returns labels in the requested language only; both are listed here for reference. Fetch once and cache.

statuses.meaning: Waiting for staff approval. Becomes rejected automatically if still pending when the booking starts (points refunded).
Booked. Includes a booking in progress (checked in, not yet checked out).
Checked out. May still be unpaid: see status_note.
Ended without a check-in. Paid: points are not refunded. Unpaid: nothing is owed.
Rejected by staff, or closed automatically because nobody reviewed it before it started (request_status.rejection_reason explains which).
Cancelled before the cancellation deadline. Paid points are refunded.

filtering.status: Optional. One status key, or several comma-separated (status=pending,confirmed). Omitted: every booking. An unknown key is a 422. There is no `filter` key any more; one sent is ignored.
filtering.order: Bookings not yet started first, soonest first; then the rest, latest first.
filtering.is_upcoming: On every card: true until the booking starts. A booking under way is no longer upcoming.
filtering.response: {data, meta} only — no per-tab counts. meta.total is the total for the statuses asked for; meta.status echoes them ([] for all).

status_note.field: status_note (string | null) on the booking detail, GET /member/bookings/{id} (not on the list card)
status_note.rule: Null unless two bookings with the same status differ in what happened to the money. Show it under the status badge when not null.

text.ar: النقاط غير مستردة لأن الحجز لم يُلغَ قبل موعده النهائي.
text.en: The points are not refunded because the booking was not cancelled before its deadline.
Nothing is owed for this booking.

text.ar: يمكنك الدفع من التطبيق أو عند الاستقبال.
text.en: You can pay from the app or at reception.
Your points were returned to your wallet.

booking_card.fields: Exactly what the card draws. The detail (GET /member/bookings/{id}) carries the rest: status_note, the payment block, actions.can_cancel / can_extend.
booking_card.pending_payment_badge: Not a status: show it for status = confirmed with payment_state = unpaid.

booking_detail.headlines: The screen titles and messages ("Your booking request has been submitted!", "We're unable to confirm your booking.") are the app's, chosen from status. The server sends none.
booking_detail.pending_paid_wording: A pending booking paid from the wallet IS charged when it is made, and refunded if not approved: say "your points come back if the request is not approved", not "no charge until approval".
booking_detail.reference: The booking number shown as Request ID, e.g. BK-2026-00041 — a yearly series.
booking_detail.checked_in: status stays confirmed until checkout: checked_in_at set and checked_out_at null means the booking is under way.
booking_detail.cancellation: null when the booking cannot be cancelled. refund_points is exactly what cancelling gives back (0 if unpaid); refund_to is "Your wallet" or the company's name.

actions.extend_disabled_reason: You can extend only while you are checked in.

cancellation.deadline_label: You can cancel this booking until August 22, 2026, 01:00 PM.

extension.detail_field: actions.can_extend (bool) on the booking detail; true only while the booking is running, the member is checked in, the space allows it and the next slot is free. actions.extend_disabled_reason says why not.

label.ar: لا يمكن تمديد الحجوزات في هذه المساحة.
label.en: Bookings on this space cannot be extended.

label.ar: يمكنك التمديد فقط وأنت مسجّل الدخول.
label.en: You can extend only while you are checked in.

label.ar: يمكنك التمديد فقط أثناء وقت حجزك.
label.en: You can extend only while your booking is running.

label.ar: الفترة التالية محجوزة، لذا لا يمكن تمديد حجزك.
label.en: The next time slot is already booked, so your booking cannot be extended.

label.ar: تتوقف الغرفة التي تجلس فيها عن العمل كمساحة عمل مشتركة عند انتهاء حجزك، ولا يوجد مقعد آخر متاح.
label.en: The room you are seated in stops serving co-working when your booking ends, and no other seat is free.

label.ar: يُغلق الفرع عند انتهاء حجزك، لذا لا يمكن تمديده.
label.en: The branch closes when your booking ends, so it cannot be extended.

extension.latest_end_at: Latest time the member can stay ("Latest Possible Departure"). When can_extend is false, options is [] and reason explains why.
